name: Koromon
look: a little pink blob with big red eyes, two tiny fangs and two long wavy ear-stalks streaming back from its head
entry: A baby Digimon that hatched from a Digitama not long ago. It bounces about on its round body, blowing bubbles at anything it doesn't like the look of.
how: Hatch one from a Digitama (CobbleEffort: Digital), or find it: common in plains and forests.
Evolves into Agumon at level 10, learning Pepper Breath.
